test a weighted combination with inverse_error weights to exploit error differences while remaining robust to ranking instability.

test a different weighting scheme (softmax) to see if it handles unstable ranking better.
The series has high trend and seasonality but ranking is unstable; a robust central tendency like median may outperform weighted mean.

test a different weighting scheme on the already robust pool4, using softmax_neg_error to see if it improves over inverse_error.
The series has unstable ranking and high trend/seasonality; a per‑horizon weighting might exploit different best models across horizons.
test a per‑horizon weighted mean on the full pool, using the top‑k‑per‑horizon handle w8 to see if horizon‑specific selection improves SMAPE.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w9' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8765. Series context: trend strength 0.8259 and seasonal strength 0.723; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.236); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 6.067.
